description: Defines the OpenIdApplicationSettings class and extension methods for updating OpenId application descriptors based on settings, used within OrchardCore's OpenId module.

classes.name: OpenIdApplicationSettings
classes.description: Holds configuration settings for an OpenID application, including client info, allowed flows, endpoints, and scopes.

classes.name: OpenIdApplicationExtensions
classes.description: Contains extension methods for updating application descriptors from settings.

methods.name: UpdateDescriptorFromSettings
methods.description: Asynchronously updates or creates an OpenId application descriptor based on provided settings and an optional existing application.
